method: Continuous original-speed footage: OpenCV vtest source frames 404-473, 10 fps. Actual YOLO26m browser observations reprocessed with a fresh app tracker. Four identities, sequentially assigned 1-4, with no ID swaps or gaps after first detection in this selected segment.
tracker: ByteTrack-style: Kalman motion, Hungarian global assignment and spatial appearance
